items.name: 汇率换算
items.desc: 查询货币汇率并换算（open.er-api.com 免费服务，无需 API Key）
items.author: DevCodex 官方
items.manifestText: {"id": "builtin-exchange-rate", "name": "汇率换算", "version": "1.0.0", "author": "DevCodex 内置", "description": "查询货币汇率并换算（open.er-api.com 免费服务，无需 API Key）", "enabled": true, "tools": [{"name": "exchange_rate", "description": "查询两种货币之间的汇率。如 100 USD 兑换多少 CNY", "parameters": "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"from\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"源货币代码，如 USD\"},\"to\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"目标货币代码，如 CNY\"},\"amount\":{\"type\":\"number\",\"description\":\"金额，默认 1\"}},\"required\":[\"from\",\"to\"]}", "endpoint": {"method": "GET", "url": "https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/{{from}}", "headers": {}, "bodyTemplate": null, "resultPath": "rates"}}]}

items.name: IP 归属地查询
items.desc: 查询 IP 地址的归属地与运营商信息（ip-api.com 免费服务）
items.author: DevCodex 官方
items.manifestText: {"id": "builtin-ip-info", "name": "IP 归属地查询", "version": "1.0.0", "author": "DevCodex 内置", "description": "查询 IP 地址的归属地与运营商信息（ip-api.com 免费服务）", "enabled": true, "tools": [{"name": "ip_lookup", "description": "查询 IP 归属地（国家/省/市/ISP）。留空 ip 则查当前出口 IP", "parameters": "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"ip\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"要查的 IP，留空查本机出口\"}}}", "endpoint": {"method": "GET", "url": "http://ip-api.com/json/{{ip}}?lang=zh-CN", "headers": {}, "bodyTemplate": null, "resultPath": null}}]}

items.name: 天气查询
items.desc: 查询指定城市的天气（wttr.in 免费服务，无需 API Key）
items.author: DevCodex 官方
items.manifestText: {"id": "builtin-weather", "name": "天气查询", "version": "1.0.0", "author": "DevCodex 内置", "description": "查询指定城市的天气（wttr.in 免费服务，无需 API Key）", "enabled": true, "tools": [{"name": "weather_query", "description": "查询城市当前天气。返回温度/体感/湿度/风速/天气描述", "parameters": "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"city\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"城市名，如 Beijing 或 上海\"}},\"required\":[\"city\"]}", "endpoint": {"method": "GET", "url": "https://wttr.in/{{city}}?format=j1", "headers": {"User-Agent": "curl/8.0"}, "bodyTemplate": null, "resultPath": "current_condition.0"}}]}
